details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) The issue → PR pipeline workflows (clarify / plan / implement / review_autofix)
B) The orchestrator (orchestrate / orchestrate_poll / integration-sync)
C) Consumer onboarding and updates (update_workflows, wrapper templates, seed-repo)
D) Documentation (README.md, docs/how-it-works.md, agents.md fragments)
E) Something else: please name the file, workflow or script, and link a run or issue that shows the problem (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure (please link the failing run or describe what you saw) (RECOMMENDED)
B) Make it faster or cheaper (fewer runner jobs, API calls or tokens)
C) Make it more reliable (fewer stalls, better retries or self-healing)
D) Make it easier to understand (docs, clearer logs or alerts)
E) Add a new feature (please describe the behaviour you expect)
Q3: How will we know the change worked?
Choices:
A) A specific failure stops happening, and a contract test is added to keep it from coming back (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measured number gets better (please give the number and the target, e.g. jobs per PR or run time)
C) The documentation is updated and reviewed; behaviour does not change
D) Other: please describe
